headline: Fundación WWB Colombia and A2censo Partner to Broaden Credit Access
summary: Fundación WWB Colombia and crowdfunding platform A2censo established an alliance aimed at facilitating credit access, building on a platform that has previously financed over 236 projects.
why: Strategic partnerships in alternative lending expand financing channels for small and medium-sized enterprises in emerging economies.

impacts.name: Alternative Lending
impacts.why: Collaborations between foundations and crowdfunding platforms increase capital distribution to local enterprises.
